versions.changelog:
tiktok-competitor-radar v1.0.0

- Initial release for TikTok competitor analysis & brand comparison.
- Supports keyword search with sorting and time filters, bulk retrieval of public posts by creator, and extraction of video comments.
- All results provided as structured JSON for further analysis or reporting.
- Clear execution boundaries: only fetches public TikTok data; does not log in, post, or access private data.
- Requires GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN for all operations.
- Detailed error status codes and warnings to improve clarity and troubleshooting.
